growth_signal.value: Described as fast-growing and went after a $100m benefits market.

entry.idea: Companies find it hard to set up and manage staff benefits like health cover and pensions, so Kota offers software that does it in one place.
entry.lesson: Build the shared back-end that connects many providers, and every business that needs it becomes a customer.
entry.name: Kota

growth.reason: A second, larger-in-euro-terms round in 2025 and press calling it fast-growing, but no hard numbers.

market.reason: Employee benefits is a large market used by almost every employer, though Kota starts in Europe.

tech.reason: Solid software linking many providers, but no sign of a hard-to-copy edge.

sources.title: Dublin-based Kota closes EUR 12.8 million - EU-Startups
Irish company Kota raises $14.5m in Series A

entry.twist: Kota acts as the plumbing that links employers to many benefit providers, instead of selling just one benefit.
entry.who_pays: Employers pay Kota to run benefits for their staff.
entry.why_now: More firms hire remote and across borders, and they want simple benefits tools that work online.
